nodes.speaker: 柚子
nodes.text: 新的一天。冷柜今天还算安静。
nodes.en: New day. The freezer is behaving today.

nodes.speaker: 柚子
nodes.text: 今天的任务很简单——彩虹鲜果杯。熟能生巧，别创新。
nodes.en: Today's task is simple — fruit cups. Practice makes perfect. No innovation.

nodes.speaker: 柚子
nodes.en: Not bad, much better than yesterday.

nodes.speaker: 柚子
nodes.en: Take it slow. Everyone's first day is like this.

after.speaker: 柚子
after.text: 今天就到这里。去休息吧。
after.en: That's it for today. Go rest.
